raw1.d:
The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to recharge mining equipment.
The Mining Laser will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.
ob: Mining Laser on any plant, tree or flora
buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw2.d:
Advanced material, processed from regular carbon in a Refiner.
The increased molecule density offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio.
Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a Advanced Mining Laser.
ob: Red carbon crystals on planet surfaces
Mining Laser on large carbon crystals
buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw3.d:
Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit life support system.
Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora.
Other plantlife may be scanned with the Analysis Visor to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.
ob: Harvest red Oxygen plants on most planets
buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw4.d: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.
ob: Feed certain creatures and collect droppings

raw5.d:
A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures.
Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large blue crystals. It is a key component of Starship Launch Fuel.
ob: Mining Laser on blue Di-hydrogen crystals (all planets)
buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw6.d:
A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology.
Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of Di-hydrogen and Tritium in Refiners.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw7.d:

Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw10.d:

buy: Galactic Trade Terminal (stock varies by system)

raw49.d:
A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants.
Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.

raw50.d:

raw51.d:
A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

raw52.d:

raw53.d:
Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment.
Handle with care.

raw54.d:
A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own.
Nutrient source: unknown.

raw55.d:
An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom.
Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.

raw59.d:

Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly.
Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station Scrap Dealer may find this interesting...
buy: Sell to the space station Scrap Dealer

raw69.d:
A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet.

raw70.d:
Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories.

raw71.d:
The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy.
Extracted from a creature caught within a repeating circuit of time. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

prod61.d:
A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required.
Crafted from Sulphurine and Condensed Carbon.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod62.d:
A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture.
Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Nitrogen Salt.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod63.d:
An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators.
Crafted from Hot Ice and Thermic Condensate
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod64.d:
An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator.
Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Nitrogen Salt.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod65.d:
A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers.
Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Enriched Carbon.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod66.d:
An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor.
Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Semiconductors.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod67.d:
An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials.
Crafted from Organic Catalyst and Nitrogen Salt.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod68.d:
A low temperature chamber, designed to prevent the natural decay of organic matter.
Crafted from Living Glass and a Cryo-Pump.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod69.d:
A miniature self-controlled nuclear reactor. Generates sub-stellar levels of energy in a hassle-free, widely compatible fuel module.
Crafted from Liquid Explosives and Fusion Accelerant.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod70.d:
A highly advanced computational device, essential for the complex calculations involved in warp travel.
Crafted from Circuit Boards and Superconductors.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod71.d:
A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from Paraffinium and Ionised Cobalt.
In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod72.d:
A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour.
Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Pyrite.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod73.d:
Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Dioxite.
A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod74.d:
Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Ammonia.
Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod75.d:
Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Phosphorus.
Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod76.d:
Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Uranium.
Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod77.d:
Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.
Crafted from Herox, Dirty Bronze and Lemmium.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod78.d:
Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields.
Crafted from Aronium, Magno-Gold and Grantine.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod79.d:
A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants. Producing a fusion core requires both intricate scientific skills and complex industrial processes.
Crafted from Portable Reactor, Quantum Processors and Geodesite.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod80.d:
A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous.
Crafted from Quantum Processors, Cryogenic Chambers, and Iridesite.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod81.d:
A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of technology components.
The module features an integrated nanite processor, allowing it to be quickly configured for a wide variety of uses.

prod82.d:
A delicate web of living tissue, this is the spark that will ignite a new lifeform into existence.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

prod83.d:
Though nothing more than a cluster of cells, it is already possible to detect the soft beating of this proto-heart.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

prod84.d:
Translucent and impossibly thin, this shell is no more than the merest breath of glass. And yet the potential is clear, a relentless multiplicative hardening adding constantly to its strength.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

prod85.d:
A slow knitting together of flesh, neurons and antimatter. The way this mind experiences the universe is beyond any imagining.
It requires careful attendance while it matures.

prod86.d:
This web of living tissue has grown its own metallic filaments, a mesh of silver and flesh. It crackles with its own electric charge, a network in need of its nodes.
It awaits its host.

prod87.d:
Powerful and muscular, this bionic pump sits within a network of synthetic tubes. It twitches when touched, its rhythms sensitive to the presence of other thinking entities.
It awaits its host.

prod88.d:
Translucent, reflective, iridescent, impossibly strong. This shell swiftly reconfigures itself upon damage, knitting itself back together stronger than ever before. The newly formed bonds create a memory in glass, reflecting back the light absorbed at the moment of damage.
It awaits its host.

prod89.d:
A sensitive arrangement of neurons in a stable orbit around a miniature black hole. The mind at the heart of this bionic miracle is free from the constraints of linear time, its experience an impossible web of myriad collected lifeforms.
It awaits its host.

prod90.d:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
This device appears to offer an interface between an individual entity and a greater shared consciousness. It appears derived from, but not attuned to, Korvax technology.

prod91.d:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
Organic, but aglow with heat and possessing a highly-pressurised inner vessel. This 'device' is part pump, and part accelerated evolutionary chamber.

prod92.d:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
A fine mesh of tightly woven fibre. Micro-organisms embedded within the weave allow it to regenerate endlessly, a perfect and infinite bionic skin.

prod93.d:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
Capsules of genetic material, encased in a film of living glass. Shared memories swim in the their reflective surfaces, waiting for their chance to shape the life within.

prod94.d:
A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host.
A fusion of complex circuitry and the ineffable glitch of the Traveller. Such a calculus might bind realities together, or tear them into mere simulated fragments.

prod98.d:
Unusual surface interactions cause this liquid to quickly split into small, perfect, spheres. Light refracted through one such sphere splits into colours beyond description.
Of unknown origin.

prod99.d:
A highly useful piece of survival technology, the Repair Kit allows damaged equipment to be quickly and efficiently restored to working order.
While repairing a piece of techology, the Repair Kit can be applied to any damaged subcomponent in place of the usual requirements.

A valuable piece of broken down starship, created by a Starship Outfitting Terminal at a Space Station.
Component is useful only as scrap to be sold at a Trade Terminal.

Specialist wiring and control threads, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod114.d:
An extremely fast advanced processing unit. Allows real-time solving of otherwise impossible calculations. However, protection against decoherence is not guaranteed.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod115.d:
An electromagnetic frequency oscillator, able to function in a wide-range of conditions thanks to both ferrous and non-ferrous magnetic properties.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod116.d:
A specialist optical component. Employing an impossibly polished surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.
Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod117.d:
A specialist biological catalysation device.
This unit takes advantage of naturally occurring enzymes in order to facilitate increased energy yields and faster processing in a wide range of advanced technologies.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

prod150.d:
A strange, shifting map. Though hard to focus upon, this chart appears to show the location of a nearby Sentinel Pillar. Such Sentinel strongholds house many secrets...
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

prod151.d:
The shell of a Sentinel drone, all that remains after its destruction in combat. While the exterior is physically intact, its internals have been severely burned.
Given the right tools and several exotic components, it may be possible to repair it.

prod152.d:
A thin, shimmering thread, once owned by Iteration: Gemini. This impossible fibre, once a treasured keepsake, sings on the wavelength of the Space Anomaly.
A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

prod153.d:
A vial of the portal's blue amber, given to you by Iteration: Mercury. The ether of the Atlas itself, this is primeval liquid from which it weaves the multiverse.
A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

prod154.d:
A handful of glassy orbs, once owned by Specialist Polo. Their pearlescent surface does not reflect the world around them, offering instead a mirror to different reality.
A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

prod157.d:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.
Unlike most Walker brains, this one has survived its violent extraction and is pristine and undamaged. It could potentially be installed in a new vessel...

prod158.d:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile.
Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by Iteration: Tethys. Its new-found freedom from the Atlas has been noted by the universe.

prod160.d:
A single-use device for locating a deep-space Gaseous Sentience. The lure generates an electromagnetic field of an intriguing nature to these highly advanced lifeforms.
Select the Lure and use Generate Field (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

prod161.d:
A moderate upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

prod162.d:
A significant upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

prod163.d:
An extremely powerful upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

prod164.d:
A supremely powerful upgrade for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

prod165.d:
A black-market modification for the Neutron Cannon. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential upgrades include: projectile speed, charge time, weapon damage and number of projectiles.

prod166.d:
An anomalous upgrade for the Multi-Tool's Weapon Systems. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
This eerie, glassy shard has been extracted from Sentinel debris. Its exact effect upon the Multi-Tool will not be known until after installation is complete.

prod167.d:
An anomalous upgrade for Exosuit. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
This strange fragment of debris has been extracted from Sentinel technology. Its exact effect upon suit performance is impossible to predict before the nantite foam has fully spread within the Exosuit's systems.

prod168.d:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.
A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances.
Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.
ob: Event reward: Expedition 7, Expedition 7 (Redux), Twitch Drop 6

prod169.d:
A pre-built wiring package, designed to allow easy installation of core technology. Use FE_ALT1 to begin the installation process.
%TECH_DESC%

prod170.d:
A luminous, leafy flowering plant that thrives in radioactive biomes and can be cultivated to yield a bountiful harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Radioactive climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod171.d:
A spherical fungus with internal gills, found only in toxic biomes. Fungal Clusters can be transplanted for cultivation, yielding a bountiful harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Toxic climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod172.d:
A large crystal flower with radiant blue blooms, found only in snowy biomes. Frostwort can be farmed and makes a reliable crop, and its adaptation to harsh conditions results in highly frequent harvests.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Frozen climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 1 hour
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod173.d:
A small, innocuous looking plant whose leaves periodically secrete a small amount of potent Sac Venom, a valuable trading commodity.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 3 hours 20 mins
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod174.d:
This 'living rock' is adapted to live in the extreme heat of scorched biomes. However, it can be farmed in most environments and, once established, yields a moderate harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Hot climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 16 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod175.d:
A foul-smelling, farmable flower that replicates the chemical structure of faecal matter. When planted inside, yields a harvest of Faecium.
A good alternative to collecting Faecium by hand, which requires feeding creatures and then harvesting their droppings. Gutrot Flowers must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod176.d:
A strange, potentially parasitic plant that yields an occasional harvest of the highly tradable commodity, Gravitino Balls.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 2 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod177.d:
An inedible tuber that produces a small yield of Mordite crystals.
A peaceful alternative to the process of harvesting Mordite from the corpses of creatures. Mordite Root must be grown in a Hydroponics Tray.
Approximate growing time: 8 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod178.d:
Native to barren biomes and capable of withstanding long periods of drought, Echinocactus is an edible succulent that responds well to cultivation, yielding a large but occasional harvest.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Barren climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 16 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod179.d:
A medium-sized, farmable plant that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Star Bulbs.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Ensure Lush climate before planting outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 4 hours
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod180.d:
A medium-sized, farmable Crystal Orb that yields an occasional harvest of valuable Albumen Pearls.
Suitable for hydroponic indoor planting. Cannot be planted outdoors.
Approximate growing time: 80 mins
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod181.d:
This medicinal herb is known for its pungent buds, which are harvested to produce Gek Nip. NipNip thrives in dank environments, and often grows as a weed.
Suitable for hydroponic planting indoors. Needs a tropical or humid climate before planting outdoors.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

prod182.d:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The basic generator unit is capable of powering a C-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

prod183.d:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The upgraded generator unit is capable of powering a B-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

prod184.d:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The advanced generator unit is capable of powering an A-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

prod185.d:
A starship subcomponent - the reactor core. The exceptional generator unit is capable of powering an S-Class starship.
Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

tech1.d:
The Exosuit's Hazard Protection system continually monitors and stabilises the user's environment. 
General reactive protection may be augmented with Environmental Shields, offering increased protection against specific conditions.
The device is charged with sodium-based substances. User is advised that a failure to charge the Hazard Protection system may allow their environment to become incompatible with life.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech2.d: Increases the base capacity of the Hazard Protection system, allowing the user to spend longer in hazardous environments without recharging their Exosuit.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech3.d:
The core of the Exosuit, the Life Support System continually filters and pumps breathable Oxygen.
In addition to its role in the continued existence of the Exosuit user, the Life Support Unit uses surplus oxygen to generate power for secondary systems, such as the Jetpack, Speed Augmentation and Torch.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech4.d: Increases the base capacity of the Life Support system, allowing the user to go longer between charges.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech5.d:
Provides the Exosuit with advanced movement capabilities, including temporary flight.
Control thrust with JUMP. The flightpack uses energy from the Exosuit Life Support system to pressurise and vent bursts of gas, propelling the user into the air.
Jetpack can be temporarily overloaded by gathering Deuterium-rich plants, causing a dramatic increase in available thrust.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech6.d: Increases the capacity of the Exosuit's Jetpack Tanks and Adrenal Pump Reserves, allowing the user to both fly and sprint longer.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 90 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech7.d:
Equips the Exosuit jetpack with advanced jump capabilities, allowing the user to take huge leaps with ease.
Activate jump systems by rapidly pressing JUMP.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 200 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech8.d:
User is guarded from extreme heat damage on scorched worlds.
Provides relief from intense atmospheric and solar heat through a threaded dermal distribution network of liquid frenium.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in hot environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 160 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech9.d:
User is guarded from extreme cold damage on frozen worlds.
Heat capillaries threaded through a user's suit that evenly distributes liquid calidium to maintain a comfortable body temperature.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in frozen environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 160 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech10.d:
User is protected from toxic damage.
Reactive compounds within the Suppressor remove toxic liquids that fall on the user, thereby reducing peril and choking hazards.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in toxic environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 160 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech11.d:
User is shielded from radiation damage.
Greatly reduces user peril during the exploration of irradiated worlds. Micro-vibrations increase electromagnetic wave reflection, thereby reducing absorption.
Device is charged by mineral extracts found in radioactive environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 160 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech12.d:
User is able to swim underwater for extended periods.
Absorbs gases dissolved in water through a membrane contactor that, if user is of a conventionally structured species, is placed over the mouth or facial breathing hole.
Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech13.d:
Upgrades the metallic shielding of the Exosuit's gloves.
An advanced blend of reinforced metal and catalytic shielding allows the user to safely handle hazardous substances, as well as perform the necessary feats of strength required to harvest certain farmable flora.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 80 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech14.d: Everything you ever knew is within.

tech15.d:
The smallest of sparks, housed within a containment field of unknown origins.
The seed glows with life, desperate to escape and fulfill its potential.

tech16.d:
A piece of technology, corrupted by interference from the Atlas.
Can be recycled for usable components.

tech17.d:
Improves the fuel efficiency of the jetpack's marine jets, reducing the drain on Exosuit life support systems.
Aqueous compressor units are installed into the jetpack's turbines, bypassing the large energy requirements of underwater ignition.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 350 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech18.d:
Upgrades the Aeration Membrane of the Exosuit to harvest oxygen from the Life Support system in the event of a breathing emergency, allowing the user to resurface and seek conventional fuel supplies.
Note: Long-term conversion of life support energy to breathable gas is not recommended, and may result in life no longer being supported.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 240 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech19.d:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.
Low memory capacity on this entry-level model limits translation capacity.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 90 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech20.d:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.
Parallel language processors enable a greater proportion of recorded speech to be translated.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 310 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech21.d:
An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning.
A large memory array and overclocked language processors allow the real-time translation of significant chunks of speech.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 580 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech22.d:
An automatic translation device. Device must be calibrated by pre-loading with existing translation data. Device must have network connection to Artemis to function.
Without access to host translation service, on-board circuit allows limited real-time translation of a small number of words.

tech23.d:
Spaceflight propulsion, boosts and on-demand Pulse Jumps through local system.
User is advised that Tritium is required to charge Pulse Engine. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Locate Tritium with the starship scanner (SCAN).
Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech24.d: Provides increased manoeuvrability and longer boosts during spaceflight.

tech25.d:
Vital launch and landing gear system.
User is advised that specialised, Deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation.
Hold THRUST to take off from planet.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech26.d: Upgrades the starship launch systems, decreasing the fuel cost of takeoff.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech27.d:
Photovoltaic panels fitted to the starship Launch Thrusters allow for a slow trickle charge while the ship is not in operation.
Harvested light is used to fuse di-hydrogen from the atmosphere and over time will refuel the Launch Thrusters automatically.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 460 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech28.d:
A device that modulates standard starship communication signals to enable the transport of matter as well as data.
Starships fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's exosuit over a long distance.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech29.d:
FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through Galactic Map.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech30.d:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 80 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech31.d:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech32.d:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix, preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 200 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech33.d:
Energy shield that protects spacecraft from laser fire, in-flight projectiles and accidental space debris interaction.
User is advised that catalytic elements are required to recharge device.
Operates automatically once constructed within user's starship inventory.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech34.d:
Adds a layer of superheated shielding to the starship's defense array, vaporising incoming fire.
Significantly increases starship shield performance.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 85 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech35.d:
A long range starship weapon, capable of delivering a highly explosive torpedo across massive distances.
Note: explosive damage is highly effective against unshielded targets, but ineffective against shielded targets.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 100 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech36.d: Expands the loading chamber of the starship Rocket Launcher, improving exhaust performance and allowing for significantly faster heat recovery.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 50 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech37.d:
A destructive starship projectile launcher, the weapons system of choice for the interstellar trader and pirate alike.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech39.d:
An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access detailed economic data about a system without having to visit. See collected data automatically on the Galaxy Map.
Active the scanner's internal Trade Computer with FE_ALT1 to search for highly-profitable trading surge events.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech40.d: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access conflict data in the galaxy map, without having to put themselves in harm's way.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech41.d:
A high-energy beam weapon for ship-to-ship combat. 
Though vulnerable to overheating, these highly accurate laser weapons can recharge the users's shields by leeching energy from target shield systems.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech42.d:
Rewires the Phase Beam with nanite-based circuitry, bypassing conventional reality limits on laser power.
Significantly improves heat performance.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech43.d:
A powerful starship weapon, capable of delivering extreme destruction at close range. 
Note: these particles show decreased effectiveness against shielded targets.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech44.d:
Overhauls the firing mechanism of the Positron Ejector, resulting in faster, more accurate particles.
Improves range and accuracy.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech45.d:
A rapid fire starship weapon that launches superheated globes of liquid metal at hostile targets. These projectiles are extremely effective against unshielded starship hulls.
Note: the Accelerator's internal components are vulnerable to rapid overheating. Sustained burst fire is not recommended.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech46.d:
Replaces the conventional Photon Cannon optics with an experimental glass array, boosting combat performance.
Significantly improves heat sink capacity.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 75 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech47.d:
A powerful ship-to-ship weapon, flinging plasmatic balls of ionising radiation towards the selected target. These projectiles can disable starship engines, leaving the target vulnerable to attack from other weapons.
These charged particles are extremely effective against starship shields, and considerably weaker against the metal armour of a ship's hull.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech48.d:
Replaces the heat sink of the Cyclotron Ballista by encompassing the entire unit with a heat-absorbing megastructure. Heat output is recycled to boost combat efficiency.
Significantly improves heat performance.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech49.d: FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

tech62.d:
Specialist Discovery and Survey unit.
Augments standard Scanner capabilities by projecting detailed environmental data directly over the user's visor. Allows the identification of distant points of interest.
The Visor will generate valuable data when used to study flora, fauna and minerals.
Hold AIM to operate. Press ZOOM to zoom.

tech63.d:
A Personal Surface Radar augmentation for the Multi-Tool. 
The Scanner releases a high-energy pulse that reveals any critical survival resources in the immediate area. Data is transmitted via the Exosuit directly into the user's visual nervous system.
Press SCAN to activate a local scan.

tech64.d:
A powerful lateral processor inserted into the Multi-Tool Scanning System allows the device to recharge at a significantly improved rate.
Increases potential scan frequency.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech65.d:
A self-contained circuitry upgrade for the Analysis Visor, adding real-time terrain analysis to the scanning array.
Toggle between Visor modes with SURVEYFILTERL/SURVEYFILTERR. Use Surveying Mode to detect hidden terrain resources.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 320 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech66.d:
Advanced terraforming device. This module overloads existing multi-tool systems, allowing the user to reshape regions as they wish.
Charged with metallic elements.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 50 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech67.d:
On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to overload the Multi-Tool, distorting the electromagnetic field around the user and creating a powerful personal shield.
While this field offers substantial protection against incoming laser fire, the user is advised that the Multi-Tool cannot be used for other functions while powering the shield.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 80 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech68.d: A recoil-stabilising weapon scope for precise combat.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 80 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech69.d:
Multi-Tool Mining Beam powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK.
Installs focusing optics within the Multi-Tool, allowing it to emit a high-energy beam. The beam is calibrated to excite molecules within common organic or geological objects, allowing it to operate as a highly effective mining device.
WARNING: Destruction of flora, fauna or minerals may attract Sentinel attention.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech70.d:
Replaces standard Mining Beam optics with high-grade Living Glass, allowing the beam to be effective against large and/or rare resource deposits.
The lens adapts automatically to minute fluctuations in the beam waveform, minimising scatter and increasing device mining potential.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 75 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech71.d:
Wafer-thin lens arrays are arranged in a highly calibrated matrix, focusing the Mining Beam on an atomic level.
This extra precision allows for highly efficient mining. Elements are extracted more efficiently, increasing the yield from items harvested with the Multi-Tool.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 460 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech72.d:
Generalist weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Boltcaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to supercharge Metallic Elements, firing them as high-velocity projectiles capable of causing extreme damage.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech73.d:
Inserts a powerful field ionisation device into the barrel of the Boltcaster, increasing projectile stability through the air.
Improves device accuracy and allows the user to fire for longer periods without degrading combat performance.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 90 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech74.d:
Boltcaster shots deliver added physical damage upon impact.
Grants additional kinetic energy to the user's ionised plasma distribution systems.
Operates automatically once constructed within user's Multi-Tool inventory.
tech74.note: This Blueprint is only available for players who bought the Limited Edition (PS4) version of the game, or recieved it from the day-one patch

tech75.d:
A significant upgrade for the Mining Beam.
Upgrades the Mining Laser's primary crystal chamber, boosting core beam energy while decreasing unwanted heat spill.

tech76.d:
High-impact projectile weapon. Launched plasma shells bounce off surfaces until their internal timer triggers a large explosion.
Charged with Unstable Plasma. Careless use can result in damage to user.
Press ALTATTACK to activate.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech77.d:
Large-bore projectile launcher. Propels plasma shells designed for rapid ground excavation.
Charged with Unstable Plasma. Warning: Explosive hole creation may also damage nearby organic matter.
Press ALTATTACK to activate.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech78.d:
Aggressive weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Blaze Javelin delivers instantaneous damage on targets.
Plasma charge process creates an ionised gas arc to propel projectiles at great speed. User will perceive destructive results simultaneous to the pull of the trigger.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 250 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech79.d:
Extends the firing chamber of the Blaze Javelin, allowing the internal particle accelerators to reach both greater mass and speed.
Significantly improves weapon damage.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech80.d:
Specialist close combat weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Scatter Blaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to heat and shatter Metallic Elements, firing them in a wide cone of destruction. Range is limited, but the shrapnel is highly effective at close range.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 250 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech81.d: Advanced self-lubricating components decrease friction within the Scatter Blaster, offering significant improvements to reload times.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech82.d:
Specialist rapid fire weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Pulse Spitter redirects Multi-Tool optics to ionise inserted Metallic Elements. These projectiles are launched in a rapid-fire spread, bombarding potential targets with a wave of high-energy plasma.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 250 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech83.d:
Specialist harmonic resonators allow the Pulse Spitter to split inserted ammunition, effective manufacturing more shots from fewer materials.
Increases weapon clip size.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech90.d:
A compact fusion core common to all Exocraft.
Requires fuel to function.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech91.d:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to drift.

tech92.d:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to turn sharply.

tech93.d:
Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to slide.

tech94.d:
A large and complex field-based subspace radar.
Due to their large power consumption and inherent subatomic instability, they are found only installed on Exocraft.
Press QUICK_MENU to activate the Signal Booster.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech96.d: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 320 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech97.d: An efficient plasma injector coupled to the engine that allows short bursts of speed.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech98.d: A mining laser too cumbersome for handheld operation, they are found only installed on Exocraft.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech99.d: Increases power of the Exocraft Mining Laser.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 210 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech100.d: Due to the energy requirements of this powerful weapon, they can only be fired from an Exocraft mount.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 210 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech101.d:
A thermally-efficient, inversion-proof reactor engine capable of powering the Nautilon even at extreme depths.
Powered by Hydrothermal Fuel Cells.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech102.d:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Nautilon Submarine.
A high-energy weapon system, it superheats a small body of water before launching it rapidly towards the intended target.
Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 250 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech103.d:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Nautilon Submarine.
Fires a concentrated plasma beam towards the intended target, which is then ignited. Such a trigger mechanism allows the use of high-energy optical mining systems in a liquid medium.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 450 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech104.d:
A high-detail sonar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard a Nautilon-class submarine to Analysis Visor levels, pinning to the HUD all information typically revealed by the Analysis Visor.
Press SCAN to activate the High-Power Sonar.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 10 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech105.d:
Installed into the drive system aboard the Nautilon Submarine.
Captures energy by exploiting the saline gradient in deep water environments, allowing a slow recharge of the Humboldt Drive in the event of fuel emergencies.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 350 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech131.d: A mysterious lock with several keyholes, this relic protects what must surely be a valuable treasure.

tech132.d: The chest requires a Living Pearl, harvested from the giant mother-molluscs that grow on the ocean floor.

tech136.d:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.
Quantum resonation improves the robustness of the drive during FTL travel, granting the ability to leap to stars previously out of reach.

tech137.d:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.
Hyperdrive benefits from advanced fusion that brings starship to higher warp speed and intensity. User's craft will become able to leap deeper into space, and into more distant planetary systems.

tech138.d:
An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter.
Uncapped, yet stabilised, fusion systems are threaded into user's hyperdrive. Allows starship to jump ever longer distances in deep space.

tech139.d:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.
