Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

tech141.d:
Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix, preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

tech142.d:
A powerful upgrade for the Exosuit Jetpack, allowing limited jetpack recharging while airborne.
Highly efficient compressors fitted around the jetpack exhaust take advantage of the windflow generated by persistent falling, recycling some of that energy into jetpack fuel.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 460 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech143.d:
A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing a small Portable Refiner, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface.
Unit requires fuel and is limited to refining one substance at a time.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 360 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech144.d:
A highly-advanced upgrade for the Pulse Engine, vastly increasing fuel efficiency.
Tritium supplies are redirected into a cycle of miniature black holes. Resulting micro-gravity fluctuations are harnessed to boost starship propulsion beyond conventional combustion-based approaches.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 460 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech145.d:
A highly-advanced upgrade for the Pulse Engine, vastly increasing interplanetary speed.
Naturally occuring frameshift effects within the Pulse Engine are amplified by tritium-based resonators, increasing its maximum sub-light speed.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 460 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech146.d:
A significant upgrade to the Hyperdrive that allows an instantaneous warp even while conventional systems are blocked by starship combat. Access to the emergency warp system is via the Quick Menu.
WARNING: Fast scramble systems mean the user is unable to plot a destination. Uncalculated lightspeed events will damage the unit and require frequent repairs.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 240 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech147.d: Upgrades the Infra-Knife Accelerator, compressing internal waveforms to allow an extra shot to be weaved in to the conventional fire patterns.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech160.d:
A fibrous metallic superstructure binds this warm and vital organ with the core of the ship. Without it, the ship would be nothing, a lifeless husk.
Hold PULSEJUMP to ask the heart to initiate a Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to request a speed boost.

tech161.d:
An array of distributed neurons, fused to a board of metallic strands. Complex patterns of electrical impulses weave their way across the surface, knotting each ship system together.
Hold THRUST to inquire if the ship would like to take off.

tech162.d:
A complex bio-metallic stem plugged directly into an antimatter heart. Registers high activity during interstellar jumps. It appears to delight in the complex calculations required for FTL travel.
Access long-distance navigation systems through Galactic Map. Keep the ship happy by regularly jumping between systems.

tech163.d:
This small extension to the ship's automated defense network appears to be its own autonomous organism. A small mouth in the centre of its flesh hungers for Pugneum.
During combat, it seems to hijack the neurological array and prevent fear or pain from traumatising the rest of the ship's body.

tech164.d:
A mess of sacs and sphincters, these vents generate and expel globules of plasma. When fused to the weapon systems of the ship, these are super-heated and then expelled at high-pressure.
Press SHIPFIRE to ask if the ship would direct its vents towards the current target.

tech165.d:
A complex arrangement of membranes and lens, fused atop a high-energy laser array. Incineration awaits those that meet their stare.
Press SHIPFIRE request the eyes gaze upon nearby targets.

tech166.d:
A device that modulates standard freighter communication signals to enable the interplanetary transport of matter as well as data.
Freighters fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's Exosuit over a long distance.

tech167.d:
A highly specialised addition to the Multi-Tool's mining capabilities, transforming terrain deposits into liquid sun.
A powerful laser array amplifies local solar radiation, allowing for the rapid reconfiguration of nearby mineral ores.

tech168.d:
A unique overload to the Multi-Tool's standard mining laser. Beam frequency is modulated precisely in a feedback loop with the delta-waves generated by the impact target.
Recordings of the target's experiences are thus etched into tiny fragments of metal and rendered as Fragmented Qualia. Readability of collected fragments is not guaranteed.

tech169.d:
Sublimation cooling vents and high-thermal mass buffers are installed in all structural panels, keeping the Exocraft pilot at non-lethal temperatures even in the most overwhelming of firestorms.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in scorched environments.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech170.d:
Installs a powerful heater into the Exocraft, keeping the cabin a habitable temperature even in the most freezing of conditions.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in freezing environments.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech171.d:
Double-vacuumed air filtration systems allow no trace of the planetary atmosphere into the Exocraft cabin without being thoroughly scrubbed.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in toxic environments.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech172.d:
Highly-efficient control materials are inserted into the frame of the Exocraft, neutralising dangerous incoming energy waves.
Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in radioactive environments.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech173.d:
The Icarus system takes advantage of existing metal panelling, upgrading them into photovoltaic surfaces. This reactive coating generates energy during daylight hours, offsetting fuel consumption.
Enables automatic engine recharging during the day.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech174.d: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 210 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech175.d:
A compact reactor unit, this engine is the heart of the Minotaur. It is mounted on a gyroscope to prevent fuel incidents during rapid movement.
Powered by conventional carbon-base fuels.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech176.d:
An automatically-regulated lubricant dispenser fitted to the leg joints of the Minotaur reduce friction and encourage fuel-efficient motion.
Significantly reduces fuel burn in the Minotaur's Daedalus Engine.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech177.d:
A high-detail radar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard the Minotaur to Analysis Visor levels.
Press SCAN to activate a radar sweep, revealing additional points of interest that cannot be located via a Multi-Tool scanner.
Use the Quick Menu to tune the radar to specific buildings.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech178.d:
A series of agile, high-powered jet thrusters mounted to the rear of the rear of the Minotaur. Precise use allows the Minotaur to quickly and powerfully traverse all manner of terrain.
Press and hold JUMP to activate. Limited in-flight control is possible.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech179.d:
A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
Enables conventional mining operations. Ineffective in combat scenarios.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech180.d:
An upgrade for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid's laser array system.
Amplifies the power deployed by the mining beam, increasing mining speed and enabling the processing of difficult to mine raw materials.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 210 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech181.d:
A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 210 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech182.d:
Adds Terrain Manipulation capability to the laser array of the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
A special mount allows the rapid deployment of a high-energy terrain excavator, without risking clogging the Minotaur's delicate joints and servos with dirt.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 210 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech183.d:
This powerful environmental neutralising system is plugged directly into the pilot as they enter the cockpit. The system is powered via the Minotaur's main engine and requires no additional input. Some minor pain may be noticed around the insertion site.
Renders the Minotaur pilot impervious to all environmental hazards.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 120 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech184.d:
Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the Boltcaster, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces.
Enables ricochet, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 90 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech185.d:
Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the Pulse Spitter, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces.
Enables ricochet, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech186.d:
Specialist high temperature weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK.
The Incinerator focuses internal lasers onto the naturally-occuring exhaust gases generated by the Multi-Tool. Ignition results in a highly destructive, if short range, inferno.

tech187.d:
A custom-made launch control system for high-performance starships. Sensitive gyroscopes and specialised control circuits plot custom take-off routines for increased launch speed and efficiency.
Specialised, deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation.
Hold THRUST to take off from planet. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

tech188.d:
A highly-tuned version of the conventional starship Pulse Engine. Wavefront occupancy has been pushed to the limit, creating a pulse experience that is both efficient and highly responsive.
User is advised that Tritium is required to charge the drive. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Scan (SHIPSCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.
Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

tech189.d:
This experimental drive augments conventional hyperdrive technology by distorting local geometry at the point of warp initialisation, boosting range and efficiency far beyond standard drives.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through the Galactic Map.

tech190.d:
A critical starship safety feature, vital for extra-orbital flight.
The pressuration capsule is a dedicated unit that both ensures a breathable atmosphere and prevents the catastrophic explosion of unconventional cockpit designs.

tech191.d:
A piece of otherworldy technology. Its inviting membranes are soft, gel-like, pulsing with a gentle crimson radiance.
Its warm embrace allows the user to extricate any Vile Spawn from the embryotic sacs of Hungering Tendrils.

tech192.d:
A biotechnical firewall, developed as a safeguard against textual cognitohazards. It is coated in something slippery, and has started to bubble along the surface.
Embedded beneath the skin, this grants administrative access to ancient forbidden texts bound at a Planetary Archive.
Warning: Do not unbind the forbidden texts. Exposure to forbidden texts carries extreme risk.

tech203.d: The chest requires a Trident Key, given to those who study the mysterious sites in the deep ocean.

tech204.d:
On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to manipulate the gravitational field around the user, refracting the light and creating an active camouflage effect.
This temporary effect can be used to escape unwanted hostile attention. WARNING: active camouflage will be aborted upon dramatic Exosuit manoeuvres such as jetpack activation, or by activating Multi-Tool weapons systems.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 80 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech205.d:
Non-violent projectile weapon. Launched projectiles will incapacitate nearby targets with a burst of electrical energy. Effective against both biological and electronic entities.
Charged with Unstable Plasma.
Press ALTATTACK to activate.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 150 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech206.d:
Overloads the energy beam generated by the Blaze Javelin, causing it to deliver a power electrical charge at its point of impact.
Will briefly stun any organic and inorganic entities that intersect the Blaze Javelin's beam.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech207.d:
A powerful combat upgrade for the Pulse Spitter. This module installs series of delicately calibrated fuel-injection nozzles within the firing chamber, which are used to initiate a controlled burn within its plasma projectiles.
Causes targets hit by the Pulse Spitter to burn for a short while, causing additional damage.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech208.d:
A high-energy weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. The Neutron Cannon energises atmospheric particles before propelling them towards hostile targets, delivering significant area damage
Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON. Charge the weapon with ATTACK, then release to unleash a volley of ionised particles.
While the cannon can deliver instantaneous single shots, longer charges will result in significant increases to the speed and volume of released particles.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 250 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech209.d:
A powerful upgrade to the Neutron Cannon. Additional resonance compressors allow significantly more energy to be routed through the cannon's central core, dramatically increasing operating power.
Installation will allow a fully-charged Neutron Cannon to launch additional projectiles at higher speeds.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech210.d:
A generalised upgrade for all Multi-Tool weapon systems, causing its projectiles to resonate dramatically upon impact with any appropriate electromagnetic field.
Will significantly increase the damage dealt to any organic and inorganic entities that are currently stunned.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 180 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech211.d:
A semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin for the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.
The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.
Piloting routines are highly localised. It is incapable of developing emotional bonds nor exercising independent control of the Minotaur.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 480 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech212.d:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
When installed alongside a Minotaur Laser, it transforms the mining laser into a powerful combat upgrade with the ability to deal heavy damaged to stunned entities.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 500 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech213.d:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles and serves as an excellent support weapon to the Minotaur's primary cannon.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 500 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech214.d:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 500 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech215.d:
A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid.
Will function as a semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator.
The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 480 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech216.d:
A specially tuned resonance jammer, designed to interfere with the remote cargo scans deployed by system authorities in the search for smuggled goods.
Deploy from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to deflect the probe. Note: jamming is not 100% effective.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 240 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech217.d:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.
A ramshackle ship exhaust nozzle, hand-assembled in an emergency by an outlaw. Has an occasional propensity to explode, but with no adverse effect on flight handling.
Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

tech218.d:
A high-performance solar sail, deployed automatically during flight. This advanced propulsion device generates an electric field within the sails themselves, allowing the starship to build momentum from the solar wind.
Offers substantial gains in fuel efficiency and boost performance over conventional engine systems, as well as enabling photovoltaic recharge of the starship's launch systems.

tech219.d:
An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier.
A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances.
Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

tech220.d:
This grey-market electronics module disables critical safety and pilot-assistance modules usually baked into the starship's fly-by-wire control system. Despite its dubious legal status and its implication in a series of high-speed asteroid impacts, this module remains popular with smugglers, mercenaries, and others who think of themselves as advanced pilots.
Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the starship to drift during spaceflight.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 460 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech221.d:
An upgrade to the freighter's galactic-scale sensors.
This device allows the user to access detailed economic and conflict data for a system, even without having previously visited.

tech222.d:
An unstable and highly-experimental piece of freighter hyperdrive technology. This extreme gravity device generates a wormhole deep within the freighter's reactor core, inverting the entire vessel and transporting it across the universe.
Speak to the freighter's commander to engage the drive. Warning: destination is not controllable.

tech223.d:
A critical freighter subsystem, vital for maintaining a habitable and safe environment for all on-board organic lifeforms.
Capable of generated a limited breathable atmosphere even when damaged or unpowered, but only for a short period of time.

tech224.d:
A beautiful living weave of nanotubes, laced through the vessel's neural assembly. This structure can be energised as the ship deems fit, creating a field that blocks hostile cargo probes.
Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to ask that the ship might block the scan.

tech225.d:
An infusion of cyanobacteria fills the membrane, which rests just beneath the ship's translucent dermal layer.
The membrane will recharge the Neural Assembly automatically when exposed to sunlight.

tech226.d:
The wormhole brain permits the ship vision of systems far beyond its own experience. It consists of strands of neural matter, wrapped around a micro-singularity and tethered directly to the ship's visual cortex.
Detailed economic and conflict data will become available on the Galaxy Map, should the ship permit it.

tech227.d:
Gathers resources directly from the interstellar medium, via a complex system of suction intakes and condensing tubes. The gathered substance varies with the local star classification.
Powered directly from the freighter's main electrical loop. Functionality is entirely autonomous.

tech228.d:
A personal rocketry device with a direct link to the Galactic Trade Network. This unit allows the user to load a small spacecraft with goods. Upon launch, the goods will be transported to the nearest trade terminus and automatically sold.
Summon the Trade Rocket using the QUICK_MENU.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 90 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech231.d:
Gently detaches the starship from gravitational fields, lifting it toward the stars.
The well hungers for pugneum or radiant shards, and must be sufficiently fueled before launch.
Hold THRUST to take off from planet.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

tech232.d:
Aligns the ship's electromagnetic emissions with A T L A S waves, providing basic propulsion and Pulse Jump capability.
The sub-light drive hungers for tritium or radiant shards.
Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump.
Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

tech233.d:
A raw optic organ, red and unblinking. Suspended above the ship's engines, it gazes down tunnels in spacetime, allowing FTL travel between star systems.
Direct the core's attention to remote destinations via the Galactic Map.

tech234.d:
A defensive crimson cocoon, obfuscating the ship's physical form and providing protection from collision and laser fire.
The core self-heals over time, but may be quickly replenished with catalytic elements or radiant shards.

tech235.d:
Sentinel-grade weapons system, engineered for the singular purpose of annihilating rogue ships in violation of system regulations.
Press SHIPFIRE to administer lethal force.

tech236.d:
This device allows a pilot's brain to interface with the mind of the Sentinel Interceptor, granting the pilot access to ship control systems and external sensors.
The enmeshing of the pilot's mind with that of the vessel is necessary to prevent rejection/consumption of the pilot by the ship's vestigial cockpit.

tech241.d:
This Multi-Tool is made with material and methods known to no conventional manufacturer, its core a unfathomable array of impossible optics and glassy foam. Nonetheless, there is a layer of recogniseable technology. It shows signs of having been tampered with by an unknown craftsman, who has repurposed its scanner array into a high-powered mining laser.
Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK.

tech242.d:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner, designed by Specialist Polo for the detection of atlantideum-infused sentience echoes.
On dissonant worlds, use the Analysis Visor (AIM) to locate sentience echoes. On arrival at an echo site, use SCAN to fully reveal nearby anomalies.

tech243.d:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.
The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum

tech244.d:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.
The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum

tech245.d:
A solemn power radiates from this ancient carving. Though the imagery is simple and the rendering rough, the meaning of the glyph has mathematical precision.
The glyph burns with a resonant energy in the presence of Atlantideum

tech246.d:
A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing an advanced yet portable Medium Refiner, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface.
Unit requires fuel and is able to refine more complex recipes than the standard personal refiner unit.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 580 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech247.d:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units.
Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities.

tech248.d:
An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units.
Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities.
In addition, this device can be used to locate Autophage gatherings. Use Locate Autophage Camp (FE_SELECT) to pinpoint a planetary gathering of Autophage.

tech249.d:
The geometric heart of this ancient weapon is the Runic Lens. Its impossible geometry not only concentrates light into a high-powered Mining Laser, but can also warp the local electromagnetic field so as to render the user invisible.
Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK. Select its secondary cloaking function with CYCLEALTWEAPON and hold ALTATTACK to activate.

tech260.d:
A tiny mote of stardust, no more than a speck. On closer examination, its surface is all crystalline shards and distorted crimson geometry.
It flickers with pent-up energy, demanding to be free.
Empower the mark as you discover systems, planets and objects across the universe.

tech269.d:
A groove cut into the smooth grey stone of the Portal.
A light within pulses gently, expectant.

tech270.d:
An advanced upgrade for the starship's landing system, enabling the ship to land and take off from aquatic surfaces.
A mixture of bespoke jets and re-directed exhaust fans allow the ship to hover just above the water's surface.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 240 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech271.d:
A salty membrane encases the ship, dramatically increasing its natural buoyancy.
The carapace will allow the vessel to float, making water landings possible.

tech272.d:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.
This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles, perfect for keeping hostiles in place while advancing to close range.

tech273.d:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.
This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system - a flamethrower for extreme damage at close range.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

tech274.d:
An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments.
Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.

tech275.d:

The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

tech276.d:
A deployable static platform, allowing the user to comfortably survey the seas in any weather. As well as providing a steady and easily accessible fishing spot, the Exo-Skiff also features abundant Cold Storage, granting additional space to store your catch. 
Summon the Exo-Skiff to any suitable body of water using the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).
ob: Blueprint: buy for 90 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech277.d:
A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of a sea creature.
Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

tech278.d:
A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions.
Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 1 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech279.d:
A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions. This rig was once owned by the legendary Lost Angler.
Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

tech280.d:
Insert bait or lures to attract specific fish, or to improve catch chances. Note: any foodstuff may be used as bait.
Current Bait: <%NAMETAG%>%BAIT%
Catch Rarity Improvement: <%RARETAG%>%RARE_BOOST%%
Catch Size Improvement <%SIZETAG%>%SIZE_BOOST%%
Other notes: <%TAG%>%NOTES%

tech281.d:
An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions. Return later to collect trapped fish.
Trap cycle: IN PROGRESS

tech282.d:
As the boundaries of reality begin to weaken, the risk of catastrophic breach anomalies increases.
This device monitors and maintains the local boundary strength, guarding against reality continuity errors. Supply the device with glass to maintain functionality.

tech283.d:
Extreme pressure environments - such as deep water - cause elevated stress on the Exosuit's oxygen circulation and general life support systems.
Installation of this reinforced pressurisation shell increases efficiency and protection while operating in high-pressure environments.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 320 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech284.d:
A high-powered matter teleportation device, this personal translocator allows any connected Exocraft to be instantly transported to your location, from anywhere in the galaxy.
Interfaces with the Exosuit Quick Menu for ease of use.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 640 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech285.d:
The nutrient ingestor improves exosuit performance via the automatic portioning and processing of various cooked items.
Select Begin Ingestion to commence automatic consumption of supplied ingredients.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 350 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech286.d:
Sideloads a resonant memory packet into your warp computer, allowing the ship to pass through the dissonant space surrounding purple stellar bodies.
User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 200 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

The unit is able to process the most complex recipes, but requires its own independent fuel source.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 480 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech289.d:
A mounted flamethrower specifically designed for the Exocraft. Causes extreme damage at close range.
Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 480 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

tech290.d:
Adds Terrain Manipulation capability to the laser systems of the Nautilon Submarine.
Cooled by specially designed water intakes, it is specifically calibrated to carve through the complex geology of the sea floor.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 390 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

Filaments of sinew and neuron warp and weave across the ship, their complex geometry darting between the visible world and some unfathomable dimension beyond.
These tendrils reach across time and space, searching out a long-distance link between the vessel and their target's Exosuit inventory.

conTech1.d:
Portable land registration service.
When placed, contacts Universal Cartographic Archive to establish ownership of land. Successful registration allows the construction of base modules across any site of the user's choosing.

conTech2.d: A stable, reinforced landing pad for starships.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech3.d: A trading terminal that provides instant local access to the market for resources and commodities.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech4.d: A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge health.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 5 Salvaged Data

conTech5.d:
A wall mounted module that can be used to recharge the user's Hazard Protection systems.
The Hazard Protection Unit must be kept charged with a source of fuel.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

conTech6.d:
Once activated, beacons provide a permanent navigational waypoint, facilitating repeat visits to specific locations.
Allows user to record their progress at any time.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech7.d: A buildable save point for managing your progress.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 2 Salvaged Data

conTech8.d:
A versatile scanner that detects nearby buildings. Can decrypt Navigation Data to pinpoint specific locations.
The Signal Booster can be dismantled and redeployed for easy transportation.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech9.d:
An autonomous baryogenesis reactor, this device can be left to harvest reality paradoxes and convert them into usable antimatter. User must monitor fuel levels to ensure continued operation.
The resulting antimatter is safely contained, ready for use in all standard hyperspace power units.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 20 Salvaged Data

conTech10.d:
A personal teleport device, allowing the user to move quickly between their constructed bases, as well as any Space Station Terminuses connected to their network.
User is urged to verify network integrity before inserting any matter they cannot afford to become separated from.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 2 Salvaged Data

conTech11.d:
Core Fleet Management Station. This advanced holographic communications station is vital for managing fleet expeditions from the comfort of your capital ship.
User is advised that multiple stations are required to manage more than one expedition at a time.

conTech12.d:
Portable blueprint research device.
This field-deployable research module allows the user to convert old or damaged technology modules into advanced construction blueprints.

conTech13.d:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.
The Portable Refiner can be dismantled and redeployed for easy transportation. Note: the Portable Refiner requires fuel to operate.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech14.d:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.
The Medium Refiner allows two different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 
The Medium Refiner must be installed in a Habitable Base, but does not require additional power sources.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech15.d:
A vital piece of planetary equipment. The Refiner allows gathered substances to be processed into more powerful and more advanced materials.
The Large Refiner allows three different substances to be combined into one new material, or materials to be processed at better ratios. 
The Large Refiner must be installed in a Habitable Base, but does not require additional power sources.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech16.d:
A buildable module that allows the users to adjust their personal appearance settings.
The module applies advanced holographic techniques to recalibrate the light around the user, allowing them to adopt whatever appearance they desire. Visual data must be properly formated before use.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech17.d:
A portable nutrient extractor, able to process and refine gathered ingredients into edible food products.
User is advised that consumption of generated products is entirely at their own risk.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech18.d:
A robotic farming unit, designed to automatically supply nearby creatures with food.
When powered, will attract nearby animal life. Keep bait tanks full in order to supply lifeforms with desired food.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech19.d:
A robotic farming unit, designed to automatically harvest substances from creatures. Requires power.
Creatures that are ready to be harvested for milk, eggs or other specialist produce will approach the Livestock Unit and deposit their yields. The creatures are unharmed by the process.
Will harvest produce from creatures fed by hand or via an Automated Feeder.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech20.d: A small and accessible information container for leaving messages or viewing left messages and short strings of information.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech21.d: A terminal for the composition and transmission of messages to other travellers.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech22.d: An underground secure parking facility for the Nomad light Exocraft.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 8 Salvaged Data

conTech23.d: An underground secure parking facility for the Roamer medium Exocraft.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 4 Salvaged Data

conTech24.d: An underground secure parking facility for the Colossus large Exocraft.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 8 Salvaged Data

conTech25.d: An underground secure parking facility for the Pilgrim light Exocraft.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech26.d: An advanced, fully-airlocked docking station for the Nautilon submarine.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech27.d:

Interfaces with the Exosuit Quick Command Menu to ease of use. Can be compressed and carried within the Exosuit with DECONSTRUCT for later redeployment.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 12 Salvaged Data

Can be rapidly deployed on the seabed in the event of an oxygen or other Exosuit life support emergency. Provides temporary shelter from environmental hazards, predators and other hostiles forces found in the deep ocean.

The resulting gas is compressed and processed, ready for use in all standard life support systems.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech45.d: An automated harvester for the mining of resources. Once activated, the AMU extracts minerals without the need for supervision, providing a regular yield until the site is exhausted.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech46.d:
An automated mineral harvester. Determine a site with the Surveying upgrade for the Analysis Visor. Mineral extraction rates and produced minerals will vary from site to site.
Requires power to function. Connect to Silos with Pipelines to allow collection from more convenient sites.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech47.d:
An automated gas harvester. Determine a site with the Surveying upgrade for the Analysis Visor. Gas extraction rates and produced gases will vary from site to site.
Requires power to function. Connect to Silos with Pipelines to allow collection from more convenient sites.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech48.d:
Automated storage unit. Connect to a Supply Grid using Pipelines.
Automatically stores the output of various Mineral and Gas Extractors, allowing for increased capacity and more efficient siting. Can be located a long distances from the extraction site.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech49.d:
Flexible, high-strength piping. Able to withstand a highly-pressurised internal environment.
Used for connecting various Mineral and Gas Extractors to Silos
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech50.d:
An efficient power generator, this solar array will turn sunlight into the electrical energy required to power many base structures.
Generates no power at night. Partner with Batteries to store energy for the hours of darkness.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 8 Salvaged Data

conTech51.d:
When suitably placed in an area of high field strength, efficient electromagnetic dynamos are used to generate near limitless power.
Locate appropriate sites with the Surveying upgrade for the Analysis Visor. Power output will vary from site to site.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech52.d:
A small power generator. Burns carbon-based fuel placed in its furnace tank and converts it into usable power.
Connect power generators to base structures and technologies with electrical wiring. Many parts require power to function.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech53.d:
High-capacity electrical wiring. Use wiring to connect Power Generators to your base. Most technology, as well as structures with embedded lighting systems, require a power source to operate.
Wiring can be connected to various switches to facilitate selective power flow.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 0 Salvaged Data

conTech54.d: Advanced fibre-optic cabling, designed to link one or more Short-Range Teleporters.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 0 Salvaged Data

conTech55.d:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when pulled.
Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech56.d:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when stood upon or otherwise activated.

ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech57.d:
Highly-efficient energy storage units. Connect to a power grid, and onboard power management circuits will automatically draw down spare capacity to charge its cells.
When the grid attempts to draw more power than is currently supplied, the battery will automatically deploy power to make up the shortfall.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 3 Salvaged Data

conTech58.d:
A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when an entity is detected nearby.
Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

A power management device, the switch will toggle the flow of power when used.
Switches require both power and signal wires to control a device.

conTech62.d:
A low-powered teleporter, construction for instantaneous travel across short distances.
When wired to both a power source and another short-range teleporter, allows near-instant travel between nearby locations.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech63.d:
A secure parking, summoning and customisation facility for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid.
Deploy the Minotaur from the Quick Menu. With the aid of an Orbital Exocraft Materialiser mounted inside a freighter, the Minotaur can be instantly deployed to any location within the same system as the mothership.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

conTech64.d:
A flexible upgrade circuit, compatible with all person Multi-Tools.
This module can be wired into a Multi-Tool at a Space Station Multi-Tool Upgrade Rack, granting the user more space in the Multi-Tool's internal layout to add further upgrades or technology specialisations.

conTech65.d: Spacious additional storage for inventory items.

An advanced audio generator, allowing the user to synthesise complex musical arrangements.
Multiple devices may be placed in sequence or connected to lights to generate spectacular displays.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 10 Salvaged Data

Advanced cabling, designed to link one or more Bytebeat Generators or to connect a Bytebeat Switch to the network.
The signal will synchronize connected lights and device to the generated waveform.

ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 2 Salvaged Data

Device to enable a wireless aesthetic in habitable bases.
Constructing the Electrical Cloaking Unit within a powered base will reduce the visual prominence of all local Electrical Wiring. Hidden wires will continue to supply electricity, provided they are sufficiently powered.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

conTech90.d:
The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form.
These databanks can be spent at a Construction Research Unit and used to research new Construction Blueprints.

conTech91.d:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
Provides access to low level restricted areas and outpost systems.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

conTech92.d:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
Provides access to mid-tier restricted areas and outpost systems.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

conTech93.d:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
Provides access to high level restricted areas and outpost systems.
ob: Blueprint: Manufacturing Facility (use a Factory Override Unit)

conTech94.d:
A portable data unit, compatible with most planetary fabricator facilities.
Once access has been gained to a central control terminal, the Override Unit can divert the facilities resources towards researching new product recipes.

conTech95.d:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a large interstellar starship. May be collected from freighter crashsites or salvaged during frigate expeditions.
Useless in its current form, a Research Station aboard your freighter may be able to convert it into useable technology.

conTech96.d:
A technology module harvested from the remains of an abandoned freighter found floating in space. May also be salvaged during frigate expeditions.
Pre-packed nano-expanders fill out this portable unit and graft it to an existing freighter, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply at your freighter's Upgrade Terminal.

conTech97.d:
An additional storage nodule for Sentient starships. Upon hatching, the parasite inside this sac is grafted upon the vessel, exchanging the use of its cavernous innards for vital nutrients from the host.
Use FE_ALT1 to trigger growth and begin the hatching process.

conTech98.d:
A writhing sac of genetic fluid, designed to foster the creation of new bio-infused technology for a sentient starship.
The embryo will grow into bio-technology upgrade. Begin biogenesis with FE_ALT1.

conTech99.d:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a salvaged starship. May also be collected from freighter crash sites or salvaged during frigate expeditions.
Can be used to expand starship storage capacity at the Space Station's Starship Outfitter.

conTech100.d:
Encoded navigation data. This highly portable data unit contains all relevant cartographical information for a planetary region.
May be traded with a Cartographer aboard a Space Station in exchange for usable star charts.

conTech101.d:
Encoded navigation data which, when properly decrypted, will reveal the location of a Drop Pod containing an Exosuit Inventory Upgrade.
Select the coordinates in the inventory and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

conTech102.d:
A fragment of the encryption override sequence for a freighter's emergency log.
Several parts of the sequence may be required to gain full access to recorded data.

conTech103.d: A token, entitling the bearer to support from the system authorities in dealing with pirate attacks.

conTech104.d:
The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.
The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

conTech105.d:
The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres.
The memory will manifest as an inventory expansion to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

conTech106.d:
An archived wiring package, designed to allow easy storage of core technology. Use FE_ALT1 to begin the installation process.
%TECH_DESC%

conTech107.d:
A cryogenically frozen node, designed to facilitate the archival of bio-technology for sentient starships. Use FE_ALT1 to begin the installation process.
%TECH_DESC%

conTech108.d:
An advanced survival technology module that allows expansion of a user's Exosuit Storage.
Pre-packed nano-expanders create stablised sub-warp voids within the Exosuit, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply this augmentation at the Exosuit upgrade terminal on board a Space Station.

conTech109.d:
The Utopia Overseers wish for their brave settlers to be strong and well-equipped!
This officially-licensed portable research station allows access to a generous range of technology upgrades, easily purchased with the appropriate currency!
Construct and visit your own Utopia Exosuit Station today!

conTech110.d:

conTech112.d:
The Utopia Overseers wish for their brave settlers to be strong and well-equipped!

Construct and visit your own Utopia Starship Station today!

conTech113.d:
The Utopia Overseers wish for their brave settlers to be sheltered and happy! Together, we will make Bakkin beautiful!
This officially-licensed portable research station allows access to a generous range of construction blueprints, easily purchased with the appropriate currency!
Construct and visit your own Utopia Build Station today!

conTech114.d:
A buildable holographic display, designed to visualise any discovery currently listed in your Personal Records.
Use the projector to manage these records directly, or view them from the Wonders section of the Catalogue.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 12 Salvaged Data

conTech115.d:
A significant upgrade for all Minotaur Flamethrower Units. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential improvements include: damage output, burn time and fuel efficiency.

conTech116.d:
An extremely powerful upgrade for all Minotaur Flamethrower Units. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential improvements include: damage output, burn time and fuel efficiency.

conTech117.d:
A supremely powerful upgrade for all Minotaur Flamethrower Units. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.
The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete.
Potential improvements include: damage output, burn time and fuel efficiency.

conTech118.d:
An autonomous fishing device, designed for long-term deployment in a wide-range of water conditions.
Once activated, the system will lure and trap any nearby aquatic creatures and store them for later retrieval.
ob: Blueprint: Construction Research Station (Space Anomaly) for 1 Salvaged Data

cur1.d: A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit. It occasionally twitches, as if experiencing the echo of combat.

cur2.d:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch.
A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.

cur3.d: A strange piece of technology, a gift from beyond the stars. It shimmers in a way that suggests it is not fully in this world.

cur4.d: Atlas Seed containing zonally-shifted quasi-stellar substrate. Warning: do not allow matrix to commune with this dimensional space.

cur5.d: This Atlas Shell holds the remains of a parasitic space-borne lifeform, most likely of extra-dimensional origins.

cur6.d: An Atlas Seed capable of resonating on humanoid telepathic frequencies; may attempt to subsume any subordinate intellect in close proximity.

cur7.d: An Atlas Seed shell encompassing a void element harvested from the collapse state of the last universe. Toxic if ingested.

cur8.d: Sculpted tau neutrino-boson matrix fixed within an irreplaceable Atlas Seed shell. May be semi-sentient.

cur9.d: This irreplaceable Atlas Seed is a form of matter-adapted photons coalesced into physical solidity by unknown means.

cur10.d: For unknown reasons, this unique Atlas Seed has been phased out of alignment with this quantum reality. Contents cannot be determined.

cur11.d: Atlas Seed contains neutronium elements from a catastrophic supernova event that obliterated a sentient civilization in an earlier era.

cur12.d: This one-of-a-kind Atlas Seed holds an aesthetically pleasing mathematical construct salvaged from the simulation of an alternate reality.

cur13.d: An Atlas Seed containing a time-locked quantum cilia suspended in a photonic shell. No others are known to exist.

cur14.d: A pungent bud harvested from the NipNip plant, often used to produce Gek Nip.

cur15.d: A pulsating jellied orb, this gooey sphere is warm to the touch. Its stench triggers a primal fear in mortal beings, a deep-seated gnawing that begs you to drop it and flee.

cur17.d:
Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater.
Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.

cur18.d:
The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive.
Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.

cur19.d:
A highly-pressurised fleshy orb.
One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.

cur20.d:
A powerful organic computing unit.
A glitching beat drives this miracle circuit, performing cycle after cycle in an endless, furious loop of calculation.

cur21.d: A rare and highly valuable cluster of storm crystals. These crystalline structures thrive in stormy conditions, and naturally attract lightning strikes, becoming spectacularly luminescent when ionised. Exclusively found on extreme weather planets.

cur22.d:
Gemstone formed over the course of centuries within the egg of a super-incubatory species. Highly ornamental, these gems are themselves living seeds, lucent grains of potential life.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur23.d:
A supersymmetric particle cluster created by divergent super-gravitational forces. A micro-rift is created as they form, and extraction of the orb prompts a localised reality weakening. Sentinel forces will respond to stablise any such anomaly.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur24.d:
A stabilised poison gland extracted from a terrestrial urchin. The host-urchin is actually a colony of smaller proto-creatures, a formation built on years of slow growth and cooperation.
Of use both medicinally and as a delicacy in some riskier cuisines.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur25.d:
An ancient object, unearthed from the depths of a planetary cave system. Its surface is cold to the touch, and is curiously polished despite its age.
A fusion of metal and rock, these cubes have proved resistant to industrial processing. As such, they are of value only to collectors.
Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur26.d:
A spherical gem that seems to pulsate with red light from its centre.
An extremely rare item often associated with ancient monolithic sites.

cur27.d: This strange energy orb constantly vibrates, emitting a low-frequency drone. Slight variations in the pattern repeat over and over, almost as if it is attempting to relay a message.

cur28.d:
An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

cur29.d:
A crystalline shard with an unusually dense structure. Potentially highly valuable.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

cur30.d:
A shard of pure crystalised Tritium.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

cur31.d:
A highly valuable ore chunk, ready to be processed into Gold.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

cur32.d:
Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality.
Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.

cur33.d:
A stone tablet bearing line after line of intricate runes. The words are unintelligible, an ancient dialect forgotten by all but the oldest of the Vy'keen elders.
The hand that carved this stone must have been extraordinary. The stonework is precise, delicate - and yet perfectly conveys the unyielding aggression its writer clearly possessed.

cur34.d:
A glitching, pulsing data unit. It does not seem to belong in this reality.
The cube gives the impression of a silent scream, the frozen cries of hundreds of lost minds trapped within.

cur35.d:
A metal statuette of a creature with a coin placed in its beak.
Popular with many traders who see it as an emblem of fair commerce and peace.

cur36.d:
Edible product much beloved by the Gek.
Allows beaked traders to release delightfully scented packets of gas for a prolonged period of time.
GekNip gas packets are considered an art form, and the truest representation of the Gek soul.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur37.d:
A small wooden icon carved into the shape of a Sentinel drone.
Used by warriors to enter a temporary trance-like state that eliminates their kind's need for sleep.

cur38.d: Largely ceremonial weapon. A vital part of Vy'keen tradition and culture.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur39.d:
The metallic shell of a disconnected electronic lifeform that was too distant from its kind to be refreshed with a new entity.
Highly prized by all species, not least its own.

cur40.d: Device used by the Korvax for the storage of historical and cultural information.
buy: Galactic Trade Terminals (depends on system economy)

cur46.d:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.
A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.
buy: Quicksilver Synthesis Companion (Space Anomaly) for 3,200 Quicksilver

cur47.d:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a world beset by powerful anomalies and strange colours.

cur48.d:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a dust-covered world of extreme storms.

cur49.d:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a water world covered in lush and verdant plantlife.

cur50.d:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.
When touched, conjures a powerful visions of a planet of strange anomalies, one minute a world of grass, the next a world of bizarre fungal growths...

cur51.d:
A single-use geometric beacon that probes the surrounding area for near-space anomalies. Such objects are highly unpredictable.
Select the Detector and use Begin Scan (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

cur52.d:
A single-use receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage.
Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

cur53.d:
A single-use receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage.
Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

cur64.d:
Unlocks this colour for freighter customisation.
A self-replicating cloud of highly pigmatised nano-robots swarm the capital ship, changing its external appearance.
ob: Blueprint: buy for 5000 Nanites from a technology merchant (Space Anomaly / station)

cur65.d:
A portable data drive containing the AI override codes for a Space Station Core.
The importance of the station AI core ensures that such keys are both highly regulated and extremely profitable on the black market.

cur66.d:
An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override.
This sweeping cloak was once worn by an ill-fated Traveller - obsessed with their quest to capture a cosmic leviathan, and doomed to repeat the chase for all eternity.
Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

cur67.d:
This peaceful space giant is a mutation of organism and starcraft, and can be tamed to swim through the stars alongside a fleet of frigates.
Recruiting this creature will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

cur69.d:
An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Leviathan expedition, and the lifting of a generation-spanning curse.
Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

cur72.d:
A translucent sheet of worm-vellum, inscribed with a fanatical text. It writhes when touched.
'The children were the first to notice.
A thump thump thump, thundering deep below the sand.
The first worm split the sky like black lightning as it leapt overhead. 
Worm by worm, they rose from the desert. Migrating.
Every storm season, we each hope to be chosen. We arrange ourselves in lines across the desert, arms lifted to the sky.
Anyone may enter the maw.
We are all equal under the great worms.'

cur73.d:
The coiled remains of a Hungering Tendril's digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps...
Such specialist offal is rarely traded on the Galactic Exchange and is thus highly valuable.

cur74.d:
The fragile embryo of a Hungering Tendril, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched.
May be extracted from embryotic sacs with the aid of a Visceral Synthesiser.

cur75.d:
A counterfeit starship registration document. This digital signature is guaranteed free of previous crimes or misdemeanors.
Can be used to reset any negative faction standing records at a Space Station Core.

cur76.d: Reassembled treasure coordinate data, retrieved from the victims of pirate faction The Blight.

cur77.d:
A signal receiver and amplifier, tuned to the wavelength of the unconscious mind. It is every colour all at once, splitting the surrounding light into a shimmering rainbow.
Warning: Carrying this antenna into deep space may attract the attention of cosmic megafauna.

cur78.d:
A makeshift device, cobbled from salvaged electronic components kept in deep storage for many years. This jumble of wires will attempt to make contact with the last-known remnants of the freighter's homeworld.
Select the device and select Broadcast (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

cur79.d:
Though its surface is dirtied and dull, polishing this rock reveals a deep inner glow, a glitter beneath a subtly iridescent surface.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

cur80.d:
A sinister shard of purple glass, salvaged from the destroyed remains of Sentinel machinery. Its walls are thin, and it may be broken down to access valuable Sentinel components.
Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and shatter with FE_ALT1.

cur81.d:
This complex mechanical unit was once the central combustion chamber at the heart of a Sentinel Hardframe unit.
Though now cool to the touch, it still glows with a sinister red heat...

cur82.d:
A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone.
Select the device and use Activate Flare (FE_ALT1) to signal [The Drone].
While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.

cur83.d:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile.
Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by both Iteration: Tethys and a Messenger of the Atlas.

cur84.d:
A map of a nearby planet. An inhabited outpost of some kind has been marked.
Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

cur85.d: A key of some weight, this aged piece of wrought iron must belong in a nearby lock...

cur86.d:
A strange forked key, glowing with an ultraviolet light.
Despite its primitive appearance, Exosuit scanning systems reveal traces of nanite foam upon its teeth.

cur87.d:
A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone.

cur97.d:
The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection.
A close analysis reveals the machinery itself appears to have been reconfigured, stretching and warping into a whole new form, writhing in the presence of these radiant shards of glass.

cur98.d:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies.
A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own Pilot Interface for a Sentinel Interceptor.
Status: VOLATILE

cur99.d:
A single splinter of the colossal mainframe at the heart of a Sentinel capital ship. It blinks, its solitary living eye trained upon the one piece of data it retains - the last known location of one of its fleet of Interceptors.
Select the AI Fragment and use Search Archive (FE_ALT1) to translate information about Interceptor's crash site to your starship's navigation systems.

cur100.d:
A pane of watchful g l a s s, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's Dissonance Resonators. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings.

Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read:
'The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky.
Our pathetic shells cannot follow, cannot reach its height, cannot reach its depths.
We offer ourselves to the ground.
We beg our sacrifice accepted.'

other201.d:
Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read:
'The dust was choking. 
Our eyes reddened and watered. 
But the truth was inescapable.
The veins of the Atlas had surfaced.'

other202.d:
Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read:
'Now with every storm we beg to be chosen;
Arms to the sky, faces to the dirt, calling out with all we have!
When heavy raindrops hit the earth, the veins of Atlas answer.
The rapture of our consumption is beyond words.'

other203.d:
Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read:
'We tumble as it swallows, but grip the slick walls as best we can - 
Oh! - to reach the gizzard still awake. 
Breathe it deeply! How our lungs gurgle!
The slime clogs our noses and stings our eyes, 
though in this warm darkness, we are already blind.'

other204.d:
Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read:
'Curse the agony of regurgitation, 
Curse this this feeble flesh that still confines me!
My brethren were reborn, rising from the blessed dust as fresh tendrils. 
Glistening capillaries to the great veins, slithering away into the sand.
I will be patient. Until the next storm.'

other280.d:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...
"The leviathan was like nothing I've ever seen.
So vast as to blot out the sun.
I wanted it. I deserve to have it! It will be mine.
But it resisted, would not come quietly.
It wailed and it wailed as the infra-knife carved into its meat.
It almost took me down with it. Perhaps it has. Perhaps..."

other281.d:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...
"The same nightmare chases me: a wail fills my cockpit, the dashboard controls gummed with blood.
I have given up sleep. I pulse past blurred stars.
And then there it was: majestic, drifting in the ocean of space.
Something inside me burns for it. I must have it.
Its great fin flexed toward my ship, and my hull was gone..."

other282.d:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...
"Today should have been the day. Their hour was at hand.
It must be mine. They are like nothing I've ever seen.
Everything was prepared. But it moved faster than I thought possible. As though it knew where I would fly, before I knew it myself.
A great tentacle hugged my ship, my cockpit - pressing my suit down to the bone. This suit will be my grave."

other283.d:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...
"The chase is over, and I have lost.
The giants will endure, and I will end.
As I plummeted from the sky, I saw another ship falling alongside mine. Then another, and another.
I may have imagined it. The misfiring of a dying mind...
Those creatures were so beautiful. But it is all ended now.
They will haunt my thoughts no longer."

other284.d:
A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...
"I came face-to-face with a creature more beautiful and bizarre than anything I have ever seen.
Despite no discernible eyes, I do not believe it is blind.
It was huge, glorious, serene. But then - with a flick of its tentacles, it was gone.
I have thought of nothing else since. I can only think of the whale. whale. whale. wail."
